definitions.explanation: A guest on a TV program, often an expert or celebrity, who offers opinions and analysis on the news or topics being discussed. From English 'commentator'.

examples.japanese: コメンテーター⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べた→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧コメンテーター⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出演|しゅつえん}→出演：11732_shutsuen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A different commentator appears on the program each week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧コメンテーター⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧やすく⟦{解説|かいせつ}した→解説する：17850_kaisetsusuru⟧。
examples.english: A commentator specializing in economics explained this news in an easy-to-understand way.

notes:
A regular or guest panelist on news and variety programs (especially morning 'wide shows') who reacts to topics and offers commentary. Often a specialist, journalist, or well-known personality.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦キャスター→キャスター：27958_kyasutaa⟧: anchor — hosts the program and directs the discussion
- ⟦{解説者|かいせつしゃ}→解説者：09688_kaisetsusha⟧: analyst, expert commentator — emphasizes specialist explanation, common in sports and news
